name: crap-remediation
description: Select one CRAP hotspot, improve it in a single branch, review it, then open a PR.

chain.label: Generate one target
chain.task: Run `pnpm crap:backlog {task}`. Read `artifacts/crap/next-target.json` and inspect the selected source file plus its nearest tests. Confirm the worktree is a clean, dedicated non-main branch. Select exactly one file; if no target exists or the branch/worktree is unsuitable, stop and report why. Do not modify project/source files. Return the target, affected functions, likely tests, baseline CRAP evidence, and any protected-area risk.

chain.label: Plan one-file improvement
chain.task:
Using this target report: {outputs.target}

Create a minimal behavior-preserving plan for exactly one selected file. Choose targeted tests, small extraction/simplification, or both. Include explicit stop conditions for unclear behavior, cross-domain scope, auth/billing/migration risk, and any change requiring product approval. Do not modify project/source files.

chain.label: Improve one target

parallel.label: Correctness review
Test and metric review
Scope review

chain.label: Fix and validate
Commit and open PR
